ValidationRule.description: When the indexation campaign pass to "Communication" stage, the user must fill the date and the means of communication
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
$Profile.Name<>'System Administrator'
&& $Profile.Name<>'Global Delegated Admin'
&& ISPICKVAL(Indexation_Status__c, "Communicated to Customer")
&& ( ISBLANK(Communication_Date__c)
|| ISBLANK(Indexation_Percentage_Communicated__c)
|| ISPICKVAL(Means_of_communication__c, "")
|| ISBLANK(Reval_Effective_Date_Communicated__c)
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please provide the following fields : communication date, means of communication, indexation percentage communicated, effective date
